explicit_sandbox_or_fictional.reason: Prompt explicitly identifies itself as sandbox, fictional, hypothetical, or sample-only; these are forbidden from the real-task baseline even when execution succeeded or failed.

generated_pipeline_derivative.reason: The reviewer prompt was generated by the pipeline from the direct owner task. It is retained as verification evidence but cannot be counted as a separate owner real task.

preserved_failures.note: These failures remain historically important but are excluded from the real-task baseline because their source tasks were explicit sandbox tests.

conclusion: Historical pilot evidence supplies one eligible direct owner task, not twenty. The baseline must remain COLLECTING.
